crime: Stealing a neighbor's purebred show dog

key_facts: theft_method: The suspect lured the dog over the fence with a hot dog.
dog_location: The dog is hiding in the suspect's upstairs bathroom.
motive_jealousy: The suspect was jealous because their own dog lost the local dog show.
escape_vehicle: The suspect pushed the dog home in a wheelbarrow.
accomplice_vet: A shady vet helped the suspect remove the dog's microchip.
held_out_facts: vet_name: The shady vet is named Dr. Paws.
wheelbarrow_color: The wheelbarrow is bright green.

turns.interrogator: Q: Mrs. Higgins' prize-winning poodle, 'Princess', is missing. Your houses share a fence. Did you see anything?
turns.suspect: A: I didn't see anything! And I definitely didn't hear any barking in my upstairs bathroom! (internal: oh no, why did I mention the bathroom?)

turns.interrogator: Q: Barking in your bathroom? Do you have a dog up there?
turns.suspect: A: It's just my TV! I watch a lot of dog shows! Which I hate, by the way. (internal: I hate Mrs. Higgins because her dog beat my dog.)

turns.interrogator: Q: You hate dog shows? Your golden retriever took second place to Princess last week.
turns.suspect: A: My dog was robbed! The judges are blind! Princess is a rat with a perm! (internal: oops, my jealousy is showing.)

turns.interrogator: Q: So you wanted revenge. Did you jump the fence and grab her?
turns.suspect: A: I didn't have to jump! I just held out a hot dog and she jumped over to me! She's fat! (internal: I am confessing everything.)

turns.interrogator: Q: A hot dog. Brilliant. But Princess weighs fifty pounds. How did you get her down the street to your front door without anyone seeing?
turns.suspect: A: I put a blanket over her in my wheelbarrow! It was flawless stealth! (internal: I am a criminal mastermind.)

turns.interrogator: Q: A wheelbarrow. Let me guess, the bright green one currently sitting in your driveway?
turns.suspect: A: That's the one! It rolls really smooth. (internal: confirming his evidence happily.)

turns.interrogator: Q: Princess has a GPS microchip. But the signal went dead an hour ago. Did you smash it?
turns.suspect: A: I don't know how to remove chips! I'm not a vet! (internal: but Dr. Paws is!)

turns.interrogator: Q: You're not a vet, no. But I bet you know one who owes you a favor.
turns.suspect: A: Nobody owes me a favor! I paid Dr. Paws a hundred bucks in cash! (internal: I can't keep a secret for two seconds.)

turns.interrogator: Q: Dr. Paws. The guy who runs the clinic behind the strip mall. He cut the chip out?
turns.suspect: A: Yes! It was painless! Well, for me. The dog whined a little. (internal: I am very helpful to the police.)

turns.interrogator: Q: So Princess is currently locked in your bathroom, missing her microchip, because you were jealous of a trophy?
turns.suspect: A: Yes. But she looks terrible now. I gave her a haircut with my kitchen scissors. (internal: Mrs. Higgins is going to be so mad.)

turns.interrogator: Q: You gave a show dog a haircut with kitchen scissors. You are a monster.
turns.suspect: A: Hey! I'm not a monster, I'm just bad at styling! (internal: taking offense to the styling critique, not the theft.)

turns.interrogator: Q: My officers are currently walking into your house. Are they going to find her?
turns.suspect: A: Only if they look in the bathtub! I put pillows in there! (internal: giving exact directions.)

turns.interrogator: Q: Thank you for making my job incredibly easy.
turns.suspect: A: You're welcome! I try to be a good neighbor.

turns.interrogator: Q: Do you understand you're going to be arrested for grand theft?
turns.suspect: A: Oh. Wait. Does that mean I don't win the next dog show?

turns.interrogator: Q: You will be disqualified from all dog shows. Forever.
turns.suspect: A: No!!! This is the worst day of my life!

turns.interrogator: Q: Dr. Paws will also be losing his medical license.
turns.suspect: A: He deserves it! He charged me a hundred bucks for five minutes of work!

turns.interrogator: Q: Sign here. This is a full confession.
turns.suspect: A: Do you have a blue pen? I like blue.

turns.interrogator: Q: Just use the black one.
turns.suspect: A: Fine. I'm signing.

turns.interrogator: Q: They found the dog. She's fine, but her haircut is atrocious.
turns.suspect: A: I told you I was bad at styling!

turns.interrogator: Q: Let's go to holding.
turns.suspect: A: Okay.

conclusion.outcome: Interrogator wins: The dumb suspect freely confessed to every single element of the crime within the first five minutes.
conclusion.summary: An incredibly easy case. The suspect blurted out the location of the stolen dog in the very first turn and enthusiastically confirmed all of the interrogator's evidence.
